product: Dashboard relationships are now generally available
tagline: Dashboard relationships, which let you build complex multi fact data models scoped to an AI/BI dashboard, are now generally available.
what_it_does: Dashboard relationships, which let you build complex multi fact data models scoped to an AI/BI dashboard, are now generally available. Preview This feature is in Public Preview. Define relationships and cross dataset measures in an AI/BI dashboard to model joins once and use them across all visualizations, instead of pre joining data in SQL or duplicating join logic across datasets.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Dashboard relationships, which let you build complex multi fact data models scoped to an AI/BI dashboard, are now generally available.
key_takeaway: Dashboard relationships, which let you build complex multi fact data models scoped to an AI/BI dashboard, are now generally available.
